title: Vicariously hike the Appalachian in the gorgeous A Trail Tale
summary: A Trail Tale is an interactive trail journal game that allows players to experience hiking the Appalachian Trail, inspired by Oregon Trail but without the hardships. Created by Andy Moliski with his brothers, the game features beautiful '90s-style pixel art and appeals to outdoor enthusiasts who cannot commit to a real thru-hike. The game offers a vicarious way to reconnect with nature for those whose life obligations prevent extended backpacking adventures.
content:
Inspired by Oregon Trail, but minus the dysentery. | Screenshot: Terrence O’Brien / The Verge	

I used to be an avid hiker and would try to go backpacking a few times a year. I always dreamed of thru-hiking the Appalachian Trail, but life kind of got in the way. (Turns out jobs, wives, and children aren't thrilled with the idea of you disappearing for three months.) But I've been longing to reconnect with my love of the outdoors and just recently took my kids on their first camping trip. So I discovered A Trail Tale at a really opportune time. It's an interactive trail journal created by Andy Moliski with help from his brothers Adam and Alex.
The various segments of the trail are rendered in beautiful pixel art reminiscent of a '90s S …

zh.summary: 《步道传说》是一款互动式步道日志游戏，让玩家能够体验阿巴拉契亚步道的登山经历，灵感来自《俄勒冈小径》但没有其中的艰辛。由安迪·莫利斯基与其兄弟们创作，游戏采用精美的90年代像素美术风格，吸引那些无法投入真正长途远足的户外爱好者。这款游戏为那些生活义务繁忙而无法进行长期背包旅行的人们提供了一种虚拟重新融入自然的方式。

title: Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported
summary: Alt-right figure Milo Yiannopoulos was arrested by ICE and deported to the UK after overstaying his visa and missing an immigration hearing. The British national, who came to the US in 2019, became known through his work at Breitbart and early support of Donald Trump. His deportation marks a significant consequence for his controversial public presence.
content:
Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos was arrested by ICE on Thursday, and today the Department of Homeland Security confirmed to Reuters and the Washington Post that he had been deported to the UK. Yiannopoulos came to the US legally in 2019, but overstayed his visa. After he failed to appear in court for an immigration hearing, a final order of removal was issued ​on July 22. 
The British national made a name for himself as an editor at Steve Bannon's Breitbart and an early supporter of Donald Trump's. He has had a long history of controversial statements and associations, including reportedly helping arrange Trump's dinner with Kanye West an …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: 极右翼人物米洛·亚诺普洛斯因超期居留和缺席移民听证会被美国冰毒执法部门逮捕并遣返英国。这位英国籍人士于2019年来到美国，因在布莱特巴特的工作和对唐纳德·特朗普的早期支持而闻名。他的驱逐出境标志着其有争议的公众形象所带来的重大后果。

title: Sony Music, Warner sue Anthropic, alleging a “brazen campaign” of intellectual property theft
summary: Sony Music and Warner have filed a broad lawsuit against Anthropic, alleging a systematic campaign of intellectual property theft and illegal piracy. The lawsuit represents escalating legal action against the AI company for copyright infringement.
content: This latest lawsuit is particularly broad and homes in on accusations of illegal piracy.

title: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
summary: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic in federal court for infringement of tens of thousands of copyrighted works, seeking damages that could reach several billion dollars with maximum penalties. This follows Anthropic's recent $1.5 billion settlement with the publishing industry.
content:
Sony Music and Warner Chappell have filed suit against Anthropic in the US District Court for the Northern District of California seeking damages for "tens of thousands" copyrighted works. The companies are asking for up to $150,000 per work, plus up to $25,000 for each instance when identifiable copyright data was stripped. In total, the damages could amount to several billion dollars if a court finds in Sony and Warner's favor and awards the maximum amount.  
This is just the latest high-profile suit against Anthropic, which recently settled a suit brought by the publishing industry for $1.5 billion. It's also faced multiple lawsuits from …

title: At TechBBQ, Europe’s AI conversations kept coming back to: Who’s actually in control?
summary: At Europe's TechBBQ conference, investors, founders, and operators discussed central questions about human agency and control over artificial intelligence. The discussions highlight growing concern in the European tech community about AI governance and oversight.
content: Investors, founders, and operators from across Europe arrived for the annual Nordic TechBBQ conference to talk about how humans can have agency over AI.

zh.title: 在TechBBQ大会上，欧洲关于人工智能的对话不断回到：谁真正掌控？
zh.summary: 在欧洲TechBBQ大会上，投资者、创始人和运营者讨论了关于人类代理权和对人工智能控制的核心问题。这些讨论突显了欧洲科技社区对AI治理和监督日益增长的担忧。

title: “We’re not doing 30 bets a year”: Vijay Pande on betting small after running $4 billion at a16z
summary: Vijay Pande, who left a16z's $4 billion biotech practice to launch AI-native VZVC, discusses how biology is shifting from discovery to engineering science. He emphasizes that open, shared datasets—not proprietary platforms—will unlock AI's transformative potential in medicine despite the continued high cost of clinical trials.
content: Vijay Pande — who left a16z's roughly $4 billion biotech practice last year to start the much smaller, AI-native VZVC — talks about why biology is finally shifting from a "discovery" science to an "engineering" one, why clinical trials are still brutally expensive, and why he thinks open, shared datasets (not walled-off ones) are what will actually let AI transform medicine.

zh.title: "我们每年不做30个投资"：Vijay Pande在a16z管理40亿美元后谈精准下注
zh.summary: 曾在a16z的40亿美元生物技术实践中工作、现已创办AI原生VZVC的Vijay Pande讨论了生物学如何从发现转向工程科学。他强调开放共享的数据集而非专有平台将解锁AI在医学中的变革潜力，尽管临床试验的成本仍然高昂。

title: Hollywood celebs are getting into microdrama apps
summary: Hollywood celebrities are increasingly turning to microdramas, an emerging digital entertainment format, as an alternative to traditional film and television. The shift reflects growing interest in new content platforms and formats outside conventional production structures.
content: Several Hollywood celebs are ditching the massive eight-figure checks and exotic movie sets for a rising format: microdramas.

zh.summary: 好莱坞明星越来越多地转向微剧，这是一种新兴的数字娱乐格式，作为传统电影和电视的替代品。这一转变反映了对传统制作结构之外的新内容平台和格式的日益增长的兴趣。

title: Distraction-free writing gadget BYOK is adding custom extensions
summary: BYOK, a minimalist distraction-free writing gadget, is adding custom extensions to accommodate diverse user needs including screenplays and novel organization. The expansion addresses the challenge of balancing pure text focus with demands for additional functionality.
content:
BYOK is a no-frills, single-purpose gadget that 90 percent of people will find absolutely frivolous. But for those who spend a significant chunk of their lives putting words to virtual paper, there is an obvious allure. Personally, I think it's at its best when you just stick to the bare minimum, focusing on pure text drafting. Certain users, though, need more. They want BYOK to take notes, they want to use it for writing screenplays, or maybe they want to organize a sprawling novel. 
Balancing the wants and needs of these more demanding users has been a challenge that BYOK founder Nick Sjolinder has been trying to figure out how to tackle. …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.summary: BYOK是一款极简的无干扰写作小工具，正在添加自定义扩展以满足用户多样化需求，包括剧本创作和小说组织功能。这一扩展解决了在保持纯文本专注和满足额外功能需求之间的平衡问题。

title: Welcome to Night Vale cocreator Joseph Fink learned storytelling from Grim Fandango
summary: Welcome to Night Vale cocreator Joseph Fink has shaped his storytelling craft through video games and multiple podcast projects exploring fiction, noir, and cosmic horror themes. His diverse creative work demonstrates the breadth and sophistication of modern audio fiction storytelling.
content:
10 out of 10 beard. | Photo: Ben Mekler	

Joseph Fink is the cocreator and cowriter of Welcome to Night Vale, arguably the most important fiction podcast ever. He's also the creator of the noir podcast Unlicensed and Alice Isn't Dead, which takes some of the conspiratorial cosmic horror of Night Vale and turns it into fodder for a more serious series about relationships, trauma, and the open road. There's also a sequel series out now called Don't Tell Alice that takes the story down an even darker path in which protagonist Keisha is the one with a secret.
Joseph is also an accomplished author. In addition to co-writing the three Welcome to Night Vale novels, he's also penned the Al …

title: Nvidia’s AI advantage is moving beyond the GPU
summary: Nvidia's AI competitive advantage is expanding beyond GPUs to comprehensive data center systems that improve efficiency through intelligent traffic management and optimization. This evolution reflects how AI infrastructure is becoming increasingly sophisticated beyond raw processing power.
content: The new generation of data center systems is increasing efficiency with smarter traffic control instead of just more processor cycles.

title: The Galaxy Z Flip 8 is at its best when there’s friction
summary: Samsung's Galaxy Z Flip 8 emphasizes closed-phone usage with a redesigned cover screen that functions like a full Android experience rather than basic notifications. The shift directly addresses user demand for comprehensive functionality on the external display without opening the device.
content:
The Z Flip 8 is designed to be used shut more than ever before. | Photo: Dominic Preston / The Verge	

What do you want from a flip phone when it's closed? A simple interface, perhaps notifications and a widget or two, for handling the basics? Or a fully fledged Android experience shrunk down for the Flip form factor? For years, Samsung has insisted on the former, even as some fans - and Razr rival Motorola - have pushed for the latter. With the Galaxy Z Flip 8, Samsung has given in.
Although the Z Flip 8's hardware is almost unchanged year-on-year, Samsung has fundamentally rethought how this phone is meant to be used when shut. The cover screen feels more like a regular Android phone, with easier access to the full versions of every single …

title: Musicians-turned-detectives are hunting for AI grifters
summary: Generative AI music tools have led to an influx of algorithmically-derived content, with some creators failing to disclose their use of the technology until public pressure forced transparency. Musicians, particularly in electronic dance music, are increasingly taking on detective roles to identify undisclosed AI-generated work. The issue raises urgent questions about authenticity and artistic integrity in technologically-focused music spaces.
content:
As audio-focused generative tools and platforms have gotten more sophisticated, the internet has become increasingly filled with AI-generated music whose melodies and vocals are algorithmically derived from the work of human artists. While some of the people pumping out this kind of content immediately own up to using AI, others have denied using the technology until increasing public scrutiny forced them to tell the truth. 
For musicians - especially those creating art in technologically-focused spaces like electronic dance music - the increasingly complicated question of what is "real" and what isn't feels particularly urgent and personal …
Read the full story at The Verge.

title: I asked 100 companies for my data. Some deleted it instead.
summary: A test of 100 companies' privacy request handling found inconsistent responses, with some companies deleting data instead of properly fulfilling access requests. The findings highlight widespread confusion and systemic failures in how organizations comply with data privacy regulations. This underscores the challenges consumers face when exercising their data rights.
content: Testing 100 companies found privacy requests often led to confusion and dead ends.

zh.title: 我向100家公司索要数据。有些公司反而删除了这些数据。
zh.summary: 对100家公司隐私请求处理的测试发现反应不一致，一些公司删除数据而不是妥善履行访问请求。这些发现突显了组织在遵守数据隐私法规方面的广泛混淆和系统性故障。这强调了消费者在行使数据权利时面临的挑战。
